title: Spike: Cloudflare Artifacts as run-scoped git (worker branches off GitHub; push events instead of polling)
description: Artifacts (open beta 2026-10-01, billed from 2026-10-14, https://blog.cloudflare.com/next-git-platform-on-cloudflare/): Git-compatible repos on Cloudflare with Workers bindings (create/fork/tokens) and repository event subscriptions (push/clone). Candidate: each run gets an Artifacts repo forked from the epic branch; workers push attempt/landing/wip branches there instead of GitHub (no 2000-branch build-up — #149, 6is; no GitHub App token refusals or rate limits on the hot path); the factory subscribes to push events instead of polling for completion; only integration/epic branches and the PR go to GitHub. Investigate protocols (https clone/push), limits, pricing, latency; prototype one worker push.
acceptance_criteria: A committed decision doc with a prototype result and recommendation (adopt / not / later).
